Game Overview

In Lab Escape, the core idea is straightforward: dash through a chaotic lab, dodging obstacles in this thrilling endless runner. Test your reflexes, jump and twist to avoid capture, embracing the adrenaline-fueled escape challenge. How long can your survival instincts keep you going?
